author: thomreis
body:
#### PR description:

Update the ECAL Phase 2 simulation

- Fix an issue with the gain switch for negative analogue signals
- Use ADC to GeV constant and gain ratios from the event setup instead of hard coded values
- Make high gain window of the LiteDTUCoder configurable
- Some refactoring of the LiteDTUCoder and the EcalDigisProducer
- Put APD digis in the event
- Add a validation for the APD digis

#### PR validation:

Passes the 38434.612 workflow. No false gain switch digis are found anymore. APD digis are visible in the validation plots.
title: ECAL Phase 2 simulation updates
